name: featureflip
description: Manage Featureflip feature flags from AI agents and editors
long_description:
Create, toggle, target and clean up [Featureflip](https://featureflip.io) feature flags from an MCP client. Covers projects, environments, SDK keys, segments, targeting rules, variations and webhooks, plus workflow tools that find stale flags, list flags that are safe to remove, and wrap a new feature in a flag with the SDK snippet for your language.

Needs a Featureflip API token: a personal token (`ffp_`) acts as you, a service token (`ffs_`) is a scoped machine identity. Every change is audit-logged against the token.

featureflip_token.title: API token
featureflip_token.description: A personal token (ffp_) from Settings → API Tokens, or a service token (ffs_) from Organization Settings → Service Tokens.

featureflip_api_url.title: API URL
featureflip_api_url.description: Management API base URL. Leave as is unless you were given a different one.

featureflip_org.title: Organization slug
featureflip_org.description: Only needed for a personal token that can reach more than one organization.
